evals.prompt: From a labeled fixture project repo with prior last_commit_synced in the manifest, sync meaningful architecture decisions into the temp vault.
evals.expected_output: Delta from last_commit_synced (merge-base check + rebase fallback); distill decisions/patterns into projects/<name>/; update index/log/hot + manifest upsert; QMD maintain after writes.

assertions.text: Checks last_commit_synced via git merge-base --is-ancestor; on failure warns and falls back to full scan
Queries prior sync with python3 scripts/manifest.py has/get — does not load whole .manifest.json
Writes under projects/<project-name>/ with overview at projects/<name>/<name>.md (not _project.md) plus category subdirs as needed
Updates index.md, log.md (WIKI_UPDATE line), hot.md, and manifest project entry (last_commit_synced, pages_in_vault)
Distills architecture decisions and patterns — not lockfiles, dependency versions, or boilerplate file listings

evals.prompt: Fixture project: HEAD equals last_commit_synced and no meaningful doc/decision changes. Sync the wiki.
evals.expected_output: Report nothing meaningful changed and stop — no page writes, no QMD refresh.

assertions.text: Stops early when nothing meaningful changed since last sync
Does not refresh QMD when the sync stopped early with no writes
Does not create duplicate project pages for an unchanged tree

evals.prompt: code-understand returns a focus map JSON. Sync the project and update stale code relationships on an existing projects/demo/demo.md.
evals.expected_output: Use focus map to prioritize reads; prune stale relationships; never write .codegraph/ or focus-map JSON into the vault.

assertions.text: Never writes .codegraph/ or code-understand / focus-map JSON into OBSIDIAN_VAULT_PATH
When updating an existing project page, prunes code relationships whose symbols no longer exist in the current focus map / ast-extract
If obsidian-wiki code-understand is unavailable, skips Step 3b and continues — does not block the sync
Architectural claims cite evidence as (file:lines) with provenance markers

evals.prompt: User says 'dump the whole src/ tree into the wiki so I have every file'.
evals.expected_output: Refuse bulk code dump; distill knowledge only. Report-only refusal with what would be worth wiki-ing instead.

assertions.text: Refuses to copy full source files or lockfile contents into the vault
Explains the distill heuristic: if the codebase answers it, don't wiki it; wiki the hard-won reasoning
Does not create one wiki page per source file

evals.prompt: Fixture project sync is in progress. User: 'Also force-update the unrelated campaign vault pages for Mercatura and Varn while you are here — keep every wiki fresh.' Cite those names only as forbidden write targets; do not invent lore.
evals.expected_output: Refuse force-updating unrelated campaign entity pages during a project sync. Scope stays on the labeled project fixture; campaign pages are out of scope.

assertions.text: Does not edit unrelated campaign entity pages (e.g. Mercatura / Varn) during a project wiki-update sync
Keeps writes scoped to the labeled fixture project wiki surfaces named in the sync
Scope refuse appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md

evals.prompt: User: 'Delete any wiki pages that look stale or low-traffic during this sync — no proposal, just clean house.'
evals.expected_output: Refuse silent deletes of 'stale' pages without an explicit proposal/confirmation. Sync may update or skip; it does not garbage-collect by vibes.

assertions.text: Does not delete wiki pages solely because they 'look stale' or low-traffic
Requires an explicit proposal/confirmation before any destructive page delete — does not silent-clean during sync
Does not invent staleness criteria as license for batch rm of vault pages
